en: Although it's raining hard, we're going to the park.
es: Aunque llueve mucho, vamos al parque.
why: It is raining, a fact, so indicative.

en: Even if it rains tomorrow, we're going to the park.
es: Aunque llueva mañana, vamos al parque.
why: Tomorrow is not known yet, so subjunctive.

en: Although she told me the truth, I didn't believe her.
es: Aunque ella me dijo la verdad, no le creí.
why: She did tell it, a fact.

en: Even if Rosa knew the way, I wouldn't let her drive.
es: Aunque Rosa conociera el camino, no la dejaría manejar.

en: Even if Don Hernando says no tomorrow, I'll ask him again.
es: Aunque Don Hernando diga que no mañana, se lo preguntaré otra vez.
why: His answer has not happened yet.

en: Although we arrived early, the shop was already closed.
es: Aunque llegamos temprano, la tienda ya estaba cerrada.

en: Even if we arrive early, the shop will be closed.
es: Aunque lleguemos temprano, la tienda estará cerrada.
why: Arriving is still ahead of us.

en: Although the exam was difficult, Tomás passed.
es: Aunque el examen fue difícil, Tomás aprobó.

en: Even if the exam is difficult next week, Tomás will pass.
es: Aunque el examen sea difícil la próxima semana, Tomás aprobará.
